notes.title: Harmony and Havoc - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi guys! 

As always - it's the patch time! 



GENERAL

New menu and card sound effects!

Last lobby background event added to the Customize tab!

(LEGENDARY HERO, Buff) Yvereum, the Steward: ATK 5 -> 6.

(LEGENDARY HERO, Buff) Gilmedah: Can now revive opponents' cards, ignoring their action cost.

notes.title: Update 28.08 – Shards of Change
notes.content:
PATCH NOTES - 28.08[hr][/hr]✨ FEATURES
Card Backs: You can now buy card backs with Shards and equip them to your deck slots.

Auction Timer Noise: Auctions now have a random extra duration to prevent players from predicting exact end times.

Sabotage Ability: Now has its own visual effect.
[hr][/hr]🐛 BUG FIXES
Auction Bug Fix: Extra copies are now prioritized for selling instead of cards in your decks.

ATK Score Fix: Indicator no longer breaks with General Ovan, Old Man Ghyadu, or Doomed Spy.

Damage Fix: Doomed Spy & General Ovan no longer take damage when opposite row cards are damaged.

Noma Jhah Fix: A stolen Noma Jhah no longer gains +4 ATK each turn.

Megilmei Fix: Works correctly when reviving with Sha-Bahr.

Illusions Fix: Illusion copies are now correctly displayed in the discard pile.

Marketplace Fix: No more freezing after overbidding and placing a new bid.

Connection Fix: The game no longer opens multiple instances if disconnected.
[hr][/hr]⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES
We’ve buffed many unplayable cards and strengthened certain deck archetypes like Ephemeral Discard, Infernal Movement, and Celestial Flying.

notes.title: Patch Update: Matchmaking & Balance
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’ve just rolled out a new update packed with features, fixes, and balance changes to keep your matches fresh and competitive. 



Here’s what’s new:


FEATURES
Matchmaking improvements for smoother, fairer matches.

Players now always have a guaranteed 150-gold quest per day.

Rerolling a quest now always gives another quest with the same reward value.

Card Upgrade Progression:

Harder to upgrade any Epic or lower-rarity card.

Much easier to upgrade any Legendary or Mythic card.

Bug Fix: Mervena can no longer be played if your opponent played a Doomed Spy on your board and sacrificed it on their last turn.

Bug Fix: The "Win Ranked Games" quest now correctly works if your opponent surrenders.


BALANCE CHANGES
BASIC UNIT (Buff)

Restless – Threefold: ATK 1 ➝ 2, Undying 1 ➝ 2

COMMON HERO (Buff)

Pachys The Cripple: All allies with up to 2 ➝ 3 ATK gain +3 ATK

COMMON UNITS (Buffs)

Kauwn the Just: Strike 1 ➝ 2

Deathsert Bandit – Ambusher: Banish 2 ➝ 1 cards, gained ability Execute 2

COMMON SPELL (Nerf)

Shatter Morale: Return a card with up to 10 ATK to the owner’s hand. Cost increase 2 ➝ 1 (max. 6)

UNCOMMON UNITS

Fuuri Igniter: Cost 4 ➝ 5 (Nerf)

Noma Jhah: ATK 6 ➝ 4 (Nerf)

UNCOMMON SPELL (Buff)

Rain Fire: Damage 4 ➝ 5

UNCOMMON HEROES (Nerfs)

Zirg the Unstoppable: Base Strike 2 ➝ 1

Fiera Olrac Ardnassak: ATK 4 ➝ 2

RARE UNIT (Nerf)

Vile Guard – Unleashed: ATK 14 ➝ 12

EPIC UNITS & HEROES

True Face of Loyalty: Up to 8 ATK ➝ up to 6 ATK (Nerf)

Mervena: Cost 2 ➝ 3 (Nerf)

Beata The Tester: Bots slightly weaker. Strike 2 ➝ 1, Protection CD 2 ➝ 3, Looter CD 2 ➝ 3 (Nerf)

LEGENDARY HEROES

Ane: Recruits now cost 0 (Buff)

Ashen Anuran: Cost 8 ➝ 10 (Nerf)

MYTHIC HEROES

Emperor Darteanesh: ATK 8 ➝ 6 (Nerf)

Zedrax, Wrath of the Council: Now only prevents playing UNITS and HEROES that don’t cost 5. Players can now cast SPELLS while this card is on the field (Buff).





Did you get here? Here is a gold code for first 100 readers! 

PROMO CODE: Gg5l9o4



That’s it for this patch!
As always, thank you for playing and keep sending us your feedback — it helps us improve Dfiance every step of the way.

– The Dfiance Team

notes.title: RANKED SEASONS - UPCOMING CHANGES
notes.content:
Dfiance now has Ranked Seasons. (starting 21.07 in browser and 04.08 on Steam)


 Players climb through the ranks, starting from Bronze IV, all the way through Silver, Gold, Emerald, Legendary, Mythic and unlikely Titan tier, receive rewards and keep pushing constantly for eternal glory.



  At the end of each Season, players are rewarded with awesome cosmetics based on how well they performed. When a Season ends, player rewards and collected cards are moved to their Eternal slot.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/1d5c0da0a42ed2fc16b89a0a58767ffb85aa237a.png"]

 When a new Season begins, player ELOs and Ranked collections are reset — allowing for a fresh start and giving new players a fair chance to compete in upcoming Seasons. 



New Seasons can also introduce game-changing mechanics, such as new factions. 

All cards collected during seasons, including player’s pre-season collections, continue to be available in the Eternal deck. 



Players will keep all the cards they have, but they won’t be able to use them in Ranked matches, only in Casual, specific tournaments and friendly matches (upcoming). 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592994/3a42546b3cc85c0cf16533260662dcbada9e97ee.png"]
